name: Cerebras Cloud inference (shared)
price_basis: USD per 1M TOKENS, representative model gpt-oss-120b Pay-as-you-go list, observed 2026-10-14. Cerebras' own pricing page renders tiers (Free / Developer PayGo / Enterprise) but the per-model rate table did not extract to a static client today; $0.35/$0.75 is the figure third-party price trackers report for gpt-oss-120b and is recorded at 0.6 confidence on the field, pending first-party re-verification. qwen-3.8-27b is reported at $0.99/$1.49 on the same secondary basis. notes: The fastest endpoint in this record set: Cerebras states ~3000 tok/s for gpt-oss-120b on shared inference and ~1850 tok/s for qwen-3.8-27b, vendor-published on its model catalog, not third-party-verified here - Artificial Analysis independently measures Cerebras in the 2000+ tok/s class on the same model, so the vendor figure is plausible rather than marketing-inflated, but it is still vendor. Shared Inference carries exactly TWO models as of 2026-10-14 (gpt-oss-120b, qwen-3.8-27b); everything else lives behind Dedicated Inference with reserved capacity. Cerebras also resells through AWS Marketplace, OpenRouter, HuggingFace and Vercel - the same silicon reachable through four different front-ends.
